title: Dr Dabber Stella Glass Mouthpiece
description:
The Stella Glass Mouthpiece brings a touch of class to your Stella with its borosilicate glass construction. It’s shaped for comfort and lets you see your vapor path, offering a cool, smooth draw that glass enthusiasts appreciate. It pairs with a high-quality adapter and medical-grade silicone o-rings for a secure fit. Easy to detach and clean, it keeps your device looking sharp. Just a heads-up, though, it’s glass, so it’s best to handle it carefully to avoid breaks. This accessory is a nice custom touch for your Stella, enhancing your experience without claiming to revolutionize it.

Included:
1x – Dr. Dabber Stella Glass mouthpiece
